inspiration.observed_pattern: A MariaDB account-provisioning procedure uses JSON_VALUE to extract a scalar attribute from a JSON document by path.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored profile-document audit. JSON_VALUE extracts nested text, numeric, boolean, explicit JSON-null, and missing-path scalars from fixed JSON column documents; procedures, account metadata, dynamic SQL, and source values are excluded.

fixture_notes: Profile 1101 has name, score, and active fields; profile 1102 has an explicit JSON null score and a false flag; profile 1103 omits score and active. JSON_VALUE must return scalar text and SQL NULL for JSON null, missing, and non-scalar paths.
determinism_notes: Profile IDs and JSON documents are fixed and ordered by the primary key; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE profile_documents (profile_id INT PRIMARY KEY, profile_label VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, document JSON NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT profile_id, profile_label, JSON_VALUE(document, '$.profile.name') AS profile_name, JSON_VALUE(document, '$.profile.score') AS profile_score, JSON_VALUE(document, '$.profile.active') AS active_flag, JSON_VALUE(document, '$.profile.tags') AS tags_scalar, JSON_VALUE(document, '$.profile.missing') AS missing_value FROM profile_documents ORDER BY profile_id
